source.snippet: Compliance officers at small fintech startups must track a stream of regulatory changes across multiple agencies and manually assemble a weekly internal digest of what is relevant to their product.

problem_statement: Compliance officers at small fintech startups must track a stream of regulatory changes across multiple agencies and manually assemble a weekly internal digest of what is relevant to their product.
target_segment: Compliance/risk leads at sub-50-person fintech startups
notes: High-budget buyer: compliance teams pay thousands for tools like Ascent and Compliance.ai. Automatable: monitor public regulator RSS/feeds, Claude filters + summarizes a weekly digest scoped to the customer's product, emailed. Hands-off after onboarding. Strong willingness to pay.
